hypothesis: Averaging single-direction alternatives may miss a target risk response that needs concurrent residual functions; test a joint two-direction branch while retaining source-learned covariance.
model: Keep every original eta source component. Prior mass 0.5 on no correction, 0.25 on A6's one-direction residual, and 0.25 on a simultaneous two-direction residual. For a pair (j,k), add delta/2 to each of the two coefficient variances, retaining the same total residual variance delta.
prior: Uniform public direction and unordered-pair probabilities, without target support. Exponential delta with the unchanged generic same-source total function variance as its mean; equal initial original source-component weights. Null probability and scale are not tuned on validation scores.
inference: Use rank-one/rank-two determinant and solve updates, then average all branches and scales. Start from A6's 48-node integration and check numerical convergence at strong-correction folds; no hard winning-pair selection or held-out fitting.
validation: Same 160 old paths, seeds 48-63, all five regimes, both source controls, both 8/24 prefixes and exact A3 candidate-group holdouts. Reuse old scores; infer joint risk structure using paid training labels only. No truth/support, verifier outcomes or future observations enter fitting.
preserved: Source covariance and means, intercept, candidate discrepancy, standardized dictionary, original queries, all f/g updates, recommendation utility and verifier.
resource_admission: Time the first complete path, retaining its result. If estimated full-cohort CPU cost exceeds the 0.25-hour local cap, stop with partial evidence; do not alter the cohort or dispatch server work.
recommendation_replay_gate: Broad learned-prior held-out improvement without material compatible-regime regression is needed before retrospective recommendation replay. No predictive result alone authorizes new closed-loop searches.
limitations: At most two extra directions is a bounded joint-structure diagnostic, not full target support learning. It uses the same development cohort as A3-A6 and cannot serve as independent confirmation or establish prospective decision gains. Preserve negative and incomplete results.
scoring: All five strata, both source controls, both prefixes, paired seed gains and nominal bootstrap intervals. Primary endpoint remains 24-batch learned-source held-out log score.
quadrature_check: Minimum null-posterior fold in each of 20 strata, plus the worst-regression fold of four retained failure paths. Compare 48/96/144 nodes; changes above 1e-4 joint log-score units require higher integration order before interpretation.
